craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). Made-up kept (kṛtrimā not false per UNC); actor simile kept whole. Rejected: (a) false → killed by UNC. (b) cutting actor → killed: actor IS the made-up. Read aloud: ITS-sta-ges — VIEWS and-the-REST … TAKES-vast VIEWS-pow-ERS.

lines: Its stages — views and the rest, all, no doubt;
made-up stages: as an actor takes his part by will, so bliss-spread self takes vast views-powers.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadbhūmikā darśanādyās sarvā eva na saṃśayaḥ | bhūmikāḥ kṛtrimā yadvan naṭo gṛhṇāti svecchayā

reads_against.argmap: Are stages certain? → Stages doubtless yet made-up, assumed like actor's roles.
c1_essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of tended glory; adbhuta of actor-assumed stages; adbhuta of shining-impure; karuṇa-vīra of confessed Lord; vīra of mirrored acts; vīra of named states; adbhuta of willing māyā; karuṇa-adbhuta of graced veiling; adbhuta of jewel-near-yet-clod
